title: Someone with Time Clock off is not offered
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock off and Technician off, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, so the list has a technician to compare with.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Approved, led by nobody (no lead).
  • Start on Work Orders, Board View, at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Reload the Board View page.
  2. Open work order 1.
  3. Open the Lead Technician dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Staff member B has a column.
  • Staff member A has no column.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 3:

  • The dropdown offers staff member B.
  • Staff member A is not offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member), story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R1: “A person is offered on a technician list at a location when all of these hold: their Technician toggle is on, their Time Clock is on, their user is active, they are enrolled at that location, and their role is not the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role.”
  • S3-N1: “A person with Technician off, or with Time Clock off, gets no Board View column, no Tech View group, and is not offered in the Technician filter or any technician dropdown, unless S3-E1 or S3-E2 applies.”
  • Key Decisions: “Who is a technician is defined by two things only: the person's Technician toggle and their Time Clock. Technician needs Time Clock: it cannot be on while Time Clock is off.”
  • Terminology: “Technician → in this PRD, a staff member whose Technician toggle is on and whose Time Clock is on. It is not the role named "Technician": a person on any role except the built-in Office User and Time Clock User roles can be one.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "5 Board View and Tech View", picture "Board View" (This build); page "6 Technician dropdowns on a work order", picture "Lead Technician" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p5-02-after-board-view.png
  • tt-p6-02-after-lead-technician.png

The design's own words:

  • “No column for her: Parth Fadadu follows Nikola Milosevic. A column only appears for staff whose Technician toggle is on and whose Time Clock is on.”
  • “Someone whose Technician is turned off but who still leads open work keeps a column for that work, so nothing they lead disappears from the board.”
  • “Not offered: Parth Fadadu follows Nikola Milosevic. The list holds only staff whose Technician toggle is on and whose Time Clock is on.”
  • “A current lead who is not a technician any more stays the lead, listed last, grayed out with the check, so the current lead never reads as blank (PRD S3-R7).”

The pictures show the Technician-off condition only; the other S3-R1 conditions are not drawn (register TT-D11, settled by S3-R1).
